text:
maya_cs: Hey team — BeaconGrove (Ravi) is asking to onboard a custom 7B legal-similarity model for clause matching/search. They want private deployment (VPC or on-prem), HSM for key management, and contract-level logging redaction. Timeline is ~6 weeks (procurement + infra). They asked for guidance on evaluation plan and a cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private.

ravi_bg: thanks Maya — yes, primary use case is e-discovery and contract similarity search across ~200k clauses. Data has PII/party names we can pseudonymize but we need strong audit controls. Also want model to surface similar clauses with a confidence score and provenance.

harper_ml: @maya_cs @ravi_bg quick Qs: how much of that 200k dataset is internal vs third-party? Are there NDAs limiting data movement? Also are they expecting fine-tuning or retrieval-augmented reranking?

ravi_bg: mostly internal (70%), some licensed corpora (30%) under NDA. Prefer fine-tuning + reranker if possible — quality trumps latency here.

liam_se: For infra: Private (VPC) + HSM is the conservative route and supports the audit/KMS needs. Dedicated could work if they allow inbound KMS federation and logs retention policy. We'll need a security questionnaire answered.

sam_support: Suggested evals: precision@5 on labeled similarity pairs, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), and calibration plot for confidence scores. Also add adversarial prompts (clause obfuscation) to check robustness. Tiny eval harness snippet: 
```
# run nearest-neighbor sim eval
python eval_sim.py --model beacongrove-7b-ft --pairs labeled_pairs.csv --metrics p@5 mrr calibration
```

intake-bot: Intake ticket created: CS-11247. Assigned to @harper_ml for model onboarding estimates and @liam_se for infra sizing.

maya_cs: Next steps — I'll send them the security questionnaire and draft an SOW. Harper, can you give an E2E estimate (compute, training, eval) by EOD Thu? Liam, can you outline options (VPC vs Dedicated) + rough monthly costs? Ravi, we'll schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to align on redaction and provenance requirements. :calendar:

harper_ml: On it. I'll include training data redaction checklist and a small eval plan and ping data-security for NDA edge cases.

ravi_bg: perfect, thanks everyone. Looking forward to the kickoff. :thumbsup:
